text: APPROVE. The `break` that only left the inner loop for one direction is now `return false` in the helper, so the `||` still goes on to the other direction, with the same -1 then 1 order and the same short-circuit on a match. The helper scores about 11 and `IsAlsoSetLive` about 1, both under 15. The change is a private static method with no new warnings that I can see, so the build should be unaffected, though I did not run it.
